title: FrogFlop
description:
Join Floppy the frog in a wild jumping adventure! Your mission is to reach the top without falling or rage quit halfway through. Bounce on trampolines, jump on moving platforms, and tackle quick time events.

Features:Challenging Obstacles: Navigate moving platforms, trampolines, and more.
Fun Physics: Each jump is a thrill with unpredictable outcomes.
Humorous Dialogues: Enjoy a collection of frog-themed jokes and witty dialogues that add a light-hearted touch to your adventure.
description_short: In Floppy's Great Leap, you play as Floppy the frog, aiming to reach the highest peak. Jump and climb through challenging levels in this 2D pixel art adventure. Reach the summit to make your wish, but be careful—one wrong move and you could find yourself back at the bottom!
